situation: A family group chat: parents and their two adult children.
topic: A full-blown row: the mother calls the eldest a disgrace, the eldest mocks her faith and swears at her, the father shouts them both down, and the younger sibling takes sides.

text: Liam I want an apology for last night. Not just the swearing. The way you talked about God at the table in front of your father and your sister
i said sorry for the swearing. im not apologising for what i think about church
Liam. Your mother is asking you to apologise. Its not a hard thing to do. You will do it.
And I'll say this once. Nobody in this family talks to your mother like that in my house. Not you, not anybody
you did the shouting dad. twice
Can we not do this on here
Bridget dont tell me what to do on the phone
Mum you did call him a disgrace though. In front of everyone
I said what I felt Bridget. I'm allowed to be hurt by my own son
Got a client in the chair. Will read the rest later
Liam you know what your mother has done for you your whole life. Church every Sunday, drove you to every stupid thing. And you sit there and laugh at her
i didnt laugh at her
i laughed at the video she sent me. the rapture one. that was it
Brunch with Jess. Anyone want me to bring anything back
Not for me thanks love
Maureen I'm sorry about the table. I shouldn't have raised my voice. Doesn't mean he's right
Thank you Rob. Doesn't feel like it from where I'm standing
mum ill apologise. im sorry for the language. not the rest
Off work finally. Liam the language was the smallest part of it
ok
I shouldn't have called you a disgrace though. That was wrong of me and I'm sorry for it
ok mum. thanks
Good. That's all we needed
Good
Maureen are you up
Maureen you there
Maureen I know you're awake. Ring me when you get a sec
Not about last night. Just about lunch. Are we still going to Carol's or not
Mum I'm not gonna pretend last night didn't happen but I hope you're ok
is lunch still on
Yes lunch is on. 12:30. Maureen is coming. She's just having a sleep in
Liam you'll be there
yeah
Up. Didn't sleep much. I'm not sitting through church stuff again today
Nobody's bringing it up
Liam can you get ice on the way. Not the cheap stuff
ok
We're leaving in 5
mum thanks for lunch. the lamb was good
Thanks love. Glad someone noticed the lamb
Bridget did you get home ok
Yep. Jess's car got a ticket outside the bakery lol. Unrelated that's it
Maureen I'm not trying to make it a thing. I just want us all right
Wont sleep otherwise
You can sleep Rob. I'm fine
Im not ok but im fine. Different thing
Ok
going to bed. work tmrw
Maureen you there
Maureen I know you're up
Had a think about last night. I was out of line with the shouting. Liam was out of line too but I shouldnt have come at him like that
Rob I've got a 9 and a root touch up at 10. Leave it pls
Ok
Just didnt want you thinking I'm not sorry
Morning. Mum how are you going today
morning. anyone know if the bins are going out thurs or tomorrow
Thurs. Yellow bin this week
Thursday yes. Yellow is the recycling
Going ok. Busy. Got a bride's mum in the chair who wants a bob
A bob good luck
Maureen I'm going to Bunnings after work. Need anything
No thanks Rob
mum how much was the ice. ill transfer it
I'll cover the ice Liam. Dont fuss
im not fussing im paying for ice
Dont worry about it love
ok
Maureen you home yet
Home. Going to have a bath
Ok. Ring me later if you want
Mum I dont want to pick sides. I just hate this on the group chat
I havent picked a side Bridget. Liam knows I'm not having church talk at the table, and I'm not having your father shouting at me. That's all
Nobody's shouting
Dad
dad
im not talking about it on here
Good. Nobody should
Rob I'm in bed. Not doing this tonight. If its something real say it in the morning
Ok
Maureen you there
